details:
if you can keep track of the actions of an user inside of a group then you can give them credit, so why not having a levelling system?

example 1

member1 goes to eventX 5 times and stays 2 hours and their microphone worked for 1 hour, they sent 10 stickers, they spawned 100 emojis, they changed avatar 365 times, they votekicked 10 people, they sent 3 chat messages, and it is the 70'th event they take part to this year, or the 10th this month so user has reached level 69 and unlocked the role Magician

Data input

now imagine if all the data in the boxes could be tracked and used to set the levelling system, and each rank could have some kind of advantage to give active members something more.

inactivity

maybe inactivity could be kept track too, not sure how but you can have so that if they don't take part to events they loose levels and they could be reaching a certain point that they just get auto-pruned for inactivity due to having a certain level below 0 with the option to have this auto-prune enabled or disabled as the group staff pleases.

also please allow groups to rename the Level for additional customization, expression, and uniqueness.
title: Group Levelling
